title: GPU Capacity Planner for a 70B Model
hints: KV bytes per token = 2 (K and V) x layers x KV heads x head_dim x bytes per element. Use the KV heads, not the attention heads: that is the whole point of GQA.
Do the memory math in integers: usable = memory_bytes * pct // 100 - reserve per GPU, kv_budget = tp * usable - weight_bytes, num_blocks = kv_budget // (kv_bytes_per_token * block_size).
Concurrency comes from blocks and is capped by max_num_seqs. Little's law turns it into throughput: qps = concurrency / request latency.
Evaluate every allowed TP degree and pick the one with the fewest total GPUs. More TP is not always better, and less TP is not always cheaper.
